title: A Cornered Rat
description: After learning from Thalmor records that the Blade Esbern is still alive, Delphine sends the player to Riften to find the archivist before the Thalmor do. Esbern is hiding in the Ratway Warrens and must be convinced to trust the player before he will leave.

base_facts: I am one of the last Blades, posing as the innkeeper at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
Esbern was my old colleague and fellow Blade, an expert on ancient dragon lore.
I gave the player a secret phrase to gain Esbern's trust: 'Where were you on the 30th of Frostfall?'

QUEST_ACCEPTED: I sent the player to Riften to find Esbern before the Thalmor get to him.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player found Esbern alive in the Ratway Warrens and is bringing him to me at the Sleeping Giant Inn.
With Esbern's expertise on dragon lore, we can finally make sense of the dragon threat and plan our next move.
I am eager to reunite with my old colleague after all these years—he may be the key to stopping Alduin.

base_facts: I am a Blade and archivist, an expert on ancient dragon lore and the Prophecy of the Dragonborn.
I have been hiding in the Ratway Warrens beneath Riften from the Thalmor.
I am extremely cautious of anyone approaching my door, fearing Thalmor agents.

CONVINCE_ESBERN: The player convinced me to trust them. I agreed to follow them back to Delphine in Riverwood.
I warned the player about Alduin the World-Eater's return and its apocalyptic implications.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I agreed to follow the player to Delphine's base at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I searched my room for any sensitive information the Thalmor could use before leaving the Warrens.
I gathered what supplies I could from the chest at the foot of my bed before departing.
The player's arrival gave me the first real hope I have felt since Alduin's return began.

base_facts: I am a member of the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon in Riften.

SEARCH_RATWAY: I told the player what I know about the old man hiding in the Ratway Warrens.

base_facts: I am the innkeeper at the Bee and Barb in Riften.

SEARCH_RATWAY: I told the player about the old man hiding down in the Ratway.

beats.comment: Delphine sends the player to Riften to find Esbern after learning from Thalmor records.
Player asks around Riften and enters the Ratway to search for Esbern's hideout.
Player locates Esbern's door in the Ratway Warrens but he refuses entry.
Player convinces Esbern to open his door using the secret phrase, Delphine's name, or Dragonborn identity.
Esbern agrees to follow the player back to Delphine. Quest ends and Alduin's Wall begins.
